title: Debit Card Declined at Grocery Merchant
description: Customer is attempting to buy groceries and their debit card was repeatedly declined despite having sufficient funds in their checking account.

customer_profile.name: Sarah Connor
customer_profile.context_summary: Active debit card flagged for potential velocity fraud after 3 consecutive contactless attempts in 5 minutes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling Apex Bank support, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi Alex, I'm at the supermarket checkout and my debit card was just declined twice. I know I have plenty of money in my checking account.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand that's frustrating. Let me pull up your account right now and check the security blocks.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you, can you clear the block so I can complete this purchase right now?

expected_summary.call_overview: Customer called regarding a debit card declined at merchant checkout.
key_issues: Debit card declined due to automated velocity fraud trigger.
